bulletin.document: Dealer Billing Price List — Price Bulletin Number SALES-2026/02
bulletin.note: Only the model rows from the attached bulletin are represented. No pricing, discount or margin information is included in this dataset or published from it.

specificationSource.rule: Specifications are copied only from the SINOTRUK dealer product pages. Where the site publishes no matching configuration, the row stays unpopulated; no value is inferred from another model.

models.name: SITRAK G7S 64480
models.matchNote: The dealer product page publishes the G7S 64480 as “6x4 T/T (480hp) Auto Air suspension G7S”, Euro 3.
caveats: Specifications are copied from the SINOTRUK dealer website for the published configuration named above.

models.name: SITRAK G7H 64480
models.matchNote: The SINOTRUK dealer site publishes the G7H 64480 only as the Euro 5 air-suspension configuration. It does not publish a spring-suspension Euro 3 G7H, so no specification is shown for this row.

models.name: SITRAK G7H 64480
models.matchNote: The dealer site publishes the G7H 64480 only with the Euro 5 engine. It does not publish a Euro 3 G7H, so no specification is shown and no Euro 5 figure is substituted.

models.name: HOWO MAX 64480
models.matchNote: The dealer product page publishes the HOWO 64480 as “6x4 T/T 480hp MAX”, Euro 3.
caveats: Specifications are copied from the SINOTRUK dealer website for the published configuration named above.

The published page states “Double sleepers, 4-point fully floating suspension”, which is cab suspension. It does not state the rear suspension, so the bulletin’s SPRING designation is not confirmed by the page.

models.name: HOWO TX 64330
models.matchNote: The dealer page publishes the 64330 as a 6x4 tipper with a 12 m³ body and automatic transmission, not the 10 CBM body named in the attached list. The running gear and engine figures are published for the 12 m³ unit and the body capacity differs.
caveats: Specifications are copied from the SINOTRUK dealer website for the published configuration named above.
Body capacity differs: the dealer page states 12 m³; the attached list states 10 CBM.

models.name: HOWO TX 64371
models.imageNote: Image shows the published 64336 18 m³ export tipper; the attached 64371 is not published on the dealer site.
models.matchNote: The dealer site does not publish a 64371. The closest published unit is the 64336: 6x4 tipper, 18 m³, export only, 9-speed manual. It is a different model number, engine and market, so these figures are not the 64371’s specification.
caveats: Specifications are copied from the SINOTRUK dealer website for the published configuration named above.
Different model number (64336 vs 64371), engine (WP12,40 Euro 2 vs the TX 371 hp family) and market (the page says “Export Only”). Do not present these figures as the 64371’s specification.

models.name: HOWO TX 84350
models.matchNote: The dealer product page publishes the 84350 as “8x4 Tipper (18m3) Auto”, Euro 3.
caveats: Specifications are copied from the SINOTRUK dealer website for the published configuration named above.
The page’s application says “Auto”, but the transmission is printed as “HW19710” without an AMT suffix.

models.name: HOWO TX 84371
models.matchNote: The dealer product page publishes the 84371 as “8x4 Tipper (25m3) Man”, Euro 2, with a 10-speed manual transmission.
caveats: Specifications are copied from the SINOTRUK dealer website for the published configuration named above.

models.name: HOWO TX 64330
models.matchNote: The dealer product page publishes the 64330 as “6x4 Water tanker 18 000L - Automatic”, Euro 3.
caveats: Specifications are copied from the SINOTRUK dealer website for the published configuration named above.
The page’s application says “Automatic”, but the gearbox is printed as “Sinotruk 19709XST” with 10 forward gears.
The published page does not state a GCM or a turning circle; those figures are omitted rather than estimated.

models.name: HOWO TX 64371
models.imageNote: Image shows the published 64300 20 000 L manual tanker; the attached 64371 is not published on the dealer site.
models.matchNote: The dealer site does not publish a 64371 bowser. The closest published unit is the 64300: 6x4, 20 000 L, manual, 300 hp. It is a different model number and engine, so these figures are not the 64371’s specification.
caveats: Specifications are copied from the SINOTRUK dealer website for the published configuration named above.
Different model number (64300 vs 64371) and engine rating (300 hp vs the 371 hp TX family). Do not present these figures as the 64371’s specification.

models.name: HOWO TX 64330
models.imageNote: Image shows the published 84340 8 m³ mixer; the attached 64330 6 m³ mixer is not published on the dealer site.
models.matchNote: The dealer site does not publish a 64330 6 m³ mixer. Its only published mixer is the 8x4 84340 with an 8 m³ drum and manual transmission, so no specification and no image are presented as this model’s.
